name: @bookingapp/root
description: BookingAPP Monorepo - Reservation and client management application

scripts.build-start: rm -rf dist && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build-start:api: rm -rf dist && npm run build && npm run start:api
scripts.db:migrate: node -r dotenv/config -e "require('dotenv').config({path: 'backend/api/.env'}); require('child_process').spawnSync('pnpm', ['exec', 'node-pg-migrate', '-m', 'backend/database/migrations', '--tsconfig', 'tsconfig.json'], {stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env, shell: true})"
scripts.db:migrate:up: node -r dotenv/config -e "require('dotenv').config({path: 'backend/api/.env'}); require('child_process').spawnSync('pnpm', ['exec', 'node-pg-migrate', '-m', 'backend/database/migrations', '--tsconfig', 'tsconfig.json', 'up'], {stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env, shell: true})"
scripts.db:migrate:down: node -r dotenv/config -e "require('dotenv').config({path: 'backend/api/.env'}); require('child_process').spawnSync('pnpm', ['exec', 'node-pg-migrate', '-m', 'backend/database/migrations', '--tsconfig', 'tsconfig.json', 'down'], {stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env, shell: true})"
